research_notes: The research should eventually quantify how much checkpoint cadence affects useful throughput, because this retry's dense writes are deliberately expensive.
However reducing cadence before boundary confidence would trade away diagnostic quality prematurely.
A later optimization can compare coarse checkpoint intervals under the validated cap while measuring expected lost-tail work.
This is secondary to the current primary goal.
The dense profile remains valid experimental work rather than padding because every batch advances analysis or evidence.
Final close remains the strict gate.
